mapper.insert: insert into batch.batch_day_instance ( tenant_id, calendar_code, biz_date, day_status, open_at, cutoff_at, settled_at, sla_deadline_at, late_count, catchup_count, timezone_snapshot, dst_policy_snapshot, frozen, operation_reason, operated_by, operated_at, version, created_at, updated_at, dry_run ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{calendarCode}, #{bizDate}, #{dayStatus}, #{openAt}, #{cutoffAt}, #{settledAt}, #{slaDeadlineAt}, #{lateCount}, #{catchupCount}, #{timezoneSnapshot}, #{dstPolicySnapshot}, #{frozen}, #{operationReason}, #{operatedBy}, #{operatedAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{dryRun} ) on conflict (tenant_id, calendar_code, biz_date) do nothing
mapper.update: update batch.batch_day_instance set day_status = #{dayStatus}, open_at = #{openAt}, cutoff_at = #{cutoffAt}, settled_at = #{settledAt}, sla_deadline_at = #{slaDeadlineAt}, late_count = #{lateCount}, catchup_count = #{catchupCount}, timezone_snapshot = #{timezoneSnapshot}, dst_policy_snapshot = #{dstPolicySnapshot}, frozen = #{frozen}, operation_reason = #{operationReason}, operated_by = #{operatedBy}, operated_at = #{operatedAt}, updated_at = current_timestamp, version = version + 1 where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id} and version = #{version}
mapper.insert: insert into batch.batch_day_open_cursor (tenant_id, calendar_code, last_scanned_biz_date) values (#{tenantId}, #{calendarCode}, #{lastScannedBizDate}) on conflict (tenant_id, calendar_code) do nothing
mapper.select: select day.* from batch.batch_day_instance day join batch.business_calendar calendar on calendar.tenant_id = day.tenant_id and calendar.calendar_code = day.calendar_code and calendar.enabled = true where day.day_status = 'FAILED' and calendar.catch_up_policy in ('AUTO', 'MANUAL_APPROVAL') and exists ( select 1 from batch.job_instance failed where failed.tenant_id = day.tenant_id and failed.calendar_code = day.calendar_code and failed.biz_date = day.biz_date and failed.dry_run = false and failed.instance_status in ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED') and not exists ( select 1 from batch.trigger_request request where request.tenant_id = day.tenant_id and request.dedup_key = day.tenant_id || ':batch-day-catchup:' || day.calendar_code || ':' || day.biz_date::text || ':' || failed.job_code and request.trigger_type = 'CATCH_UP' and request.parent_workflow_run_id is null and ( calendar.catch_up_policy = 'MANUAL_APPROVAL' or request.request_status in ('LAUNCHED', 'REJECTED', 'DUPLICATE', 'GIVE_UP') ) ) ) order by day.settled_at, day.id limit #{limit}

select count(*) from batch.scheduled_occurrence where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and calendar_code = #{calendarCode} and biz_date = #{bizDate} and ( occurrence_status in ( 'PLANNED', 'WAITING_READINESS', 'MISFIRE_PENDING' ) or ( occurrence_status = 'REQUESTED' and not exists ( select 1 from batch.trigger_request tr join batch.workflow_run workflow_run on workflow_run.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and workflow_run.trigger_request_id = tr.id and workflow_run.workflow_definition_id = batch.scheduled_occurrence.workflow_definition_id and workflow_run.biz_date is not distinct from batch.scheduled_occurrence.biz_date and workflow_run.dry_run = false where tr.tenant_id = batch.scheduled_occurrence.tenant_id and tr.workflow_definition_id = batch.scheduled_occurrence.workflow_definition_id and tr.request_id = batch.scheduled_occurrence.request_id ) ) )

select count(*) from batch.workflow_definition wf where wf.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and wf.calendar_code = #{calendarCode} and wf.enabled = true and wf.schedule_enabled = true and wf.schedule_type in ('CRON', 'FIXED_RATE') and wf.trigger_mode in ('SCHEDULED', 'MIXED') and not exists ( select 1 from batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage coverage where coverage.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and coverage.workflow_definition_id = wf.id and coverage.schedule_version = wf.version and coverage.calendar_code is not distinct from wf.calendar_code and coverage.coverage_from_at <= #{cutoffAt} and coverage.coverage_through_at >= #{cutoffAt} and coverage.last_success_at >= coalesce( (select revision.updated_at from batch.tenant_configuration_revision revision where revision.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id), '-infinity'::timestamptz) )

select count(*) from batch.workflow_definition wd where wd.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and wd.calendar_code = #{calendarCode} and wd.enabled = true and wd.trigger_mode in ('EVENT', 'MIXED') and not exists ( select 1 from batch.external_event_expectation_definition expectation where expectation.tenant_id = wd.tenant_id and expectation.calendar_code = wd.calendar_code and expectation.workflow_definition_id = wd.id and expectation.enabled = true ) and not exists ( select 1 from batch.file_group_expectation_definition expectation where expectation.tenant_id = wd.tenant_id and expectation.calendar_code = wd.calendar_code and expectation.workflow_definition_id = wd.id and expectation.enabled = true )
